summary: Full Red Team audit and implementation of Vatech 2D viewer clinical tools, 2.5x loupe, curved apex caliper, 1-click export, and toolbar Hick's law optimization

clinical_ergonomics_and_tools.magnifier_2_5x: Interactive screen-space 2.5x Loupe with glowing #00C853 ring, reticle crosshairs, and 190px lens for root apex and microcrack detection
clinical_ergonomics_and_tools.curved_apex_caliper: Multi-point curved root canal polyline caliper (Working Length / WL) with real-time mm calculation (calibrated to sensor pitch)
clinical_ergonomics_and_tools.export_5mm_ladder: 1-click high-res sensor PNG export with calibrated 5.0 mm scale ladder (±0.05 mm) and doctor clinic header stamp
clinical_ergonomics_and_tools.hud_telemetry_cleanup: Eliminated empty '— (—)' age badges and raw ISO timestamps (e.g. 2026-10-01T10:14:20.000Z), formatted as localized Russian strings
clinical_ergonomics_and_tools.toolbar_hicks_law: Dense 1-row 34-36px toolbar with segmented quick preset bar, zero wrapping, and zero multi-row clutter
